story.title: Temple Arrival
story.text: You are guiding Alex through the first courtyard. Several visitors are taking photos quietly, while a few signs explain where photography is allowed.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: This temple looks amazing. Can I take photos here, or would that be rude?

scenes.question: Which answer is the most respectful and specific?

choices.text: You may take photos only in permitted areas, without flash, and without blocking worshippers.

feedback.reaction: Alex nods 😊 and checks the nearby sign before taking a quiet photo.

choices.text: You can photograph anything if you stay quiet, even restricted murals or prayer areas.

feedback.reaction: Alex hesitates 😬 because being quiet does not cancel the rules.

choices.text: You should ask Alex to pose on the steps near the prayer area for a better picture.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks unsure 😕 because the advice could disturb people who are praying.

story.title: At the Prayer Hall
story.text: Alex reaches the entrance of the main hall. A shoe rack is placed beside the doorway, and visitors step inside quietly.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Should I take off my shoes now, or after I walk inside?

choices.text: Please remove your shoes before crossing the threshold, then place them neatly on the rack.

feedback.reaction: Alex smiles 🙌 and leaves the shoes neatly outside the hall.

choices.text: Walk inside first, then remove your shoes only if someone complains.

feedback.reaction: Alex stops 😬 because that would ignore the expected etiquette.

choices.text: Only sandals have to be removed; closed shoes are usually fine indoors.

feedback.reaction: Alex checks the sign 😕 and sees that all shoes should stay outside.

story.title: Inside the Gallery
story.text: The mural gallery is peaceful. A small tour group is listening to a guide, and other visitors are slowly observing the wall paintings.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: My friends are behind me. Is it okay if I speak loudly so they can hear the explanation?

choices.text: Please keep your voice low; if you need to explain more, step aside or wait until you are outside.

feedback.reaction: Alex whispers 🙂 and gestures for the friends to move closer quietly.

choices.text: It is fine to speak loudly because historical information is useful for everyone.

feedback.reaction: Alex notices nearby visitors staring 😬 and lowers their voice.

choices.text: Record a loud video quickly before the staff notice.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks embarrassed 😳 because that would be disrespectful and risky.

story.title: Offering Time
story.text: The courtyard is busy with people making offerings. There are posted instructions, a clear queue, and a staff member helping visitors.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: I want to join respectfully. What should I do before making an offering?

choices.text: Read the posted instructions, wait calmly in the queue, and handle incense or candles carefully.

feedback.reaction: Alex smiles 😊 and follows the queue without rushing.

choices.text: Light as many incense sticks as possible because more smoke always shows more respect.

feedback.reaction: Alex coughs 😷 and realizes the posted limit should be followed.

choices.text: Skip the signs and copy the nearest visitor, even if you are not sure what they are doing.

feedback.reaction: Alex pauses 😕 because copying without understanding could lead to a mistake.

story.title: Journey End
story.text: Alex is ready to leave the temple garden. Staff members are helping visitors near the exit while a small ceremony continues nearby.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Thank you for guiding me. How can I thank the staff politely without interrupting anyone?

choices.text: Thank them briefly with a respectful smile, and avoid interrupting the ceremony or other visitors.

feedback.reaction: Alex beams 😄 and offers a quiet, respectful thank you.

choices.text: Call the staff loudly from across the garden so everyone knows you are grateful.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks uneasy 😕 because the loud voice would disturb the atmosphere.

choices.text: Ask for special access as a reward because you were polite during the visit.

feedback.reaction: Alex frowns 😒 because politeness should not be used to demand privileges.
